name: Tokyo Yamanote Boys Super Mint Disc
original_name: TOKYOヤマノテBOYS SUPER MINT DISC
source:
Every year, just one girl from all high schools in Japan is chosen to be a “Princess”. Top high school boys from all around Tokyo are then selected to be the participants in a confession tournament that is Tokyo Yamanote Boys. It’s a love royale where the boys will confess to the Princess with various kinds of appeal. The one she picks will be crowned “Prince”, and there’s a legend that the Prince and Princess are guaranteed to have an eternally happy future together through this event.

Super mint disc focus on the three main guys for entry no.4-6: Kirishima Iori (Entry no.4), Lucy (Entry no.5), and Kujou Takumi (Entry no.6)

[From [url=http://koiiro.wordpress.com/2011/01/30/tokyo-yamanote-boys-zenyasai-disc]Love-colored sky[/url]]
translation:
每年，日本所有高中会选出一名“公主”少女。随后，来自东京各地的顶尖高中男生将参加名为《东京山手男孩》的告白大赛。这是一场恋爱大逃杀，男孩们会以各种方式向公主表达心意。被她选中的那位将加冕为“王子”；传说被选为王子、与公主结伴的两人，将拥有永远幸福的未来。

Super Mint Disc聚焦于报名编号4至6的三位主角：桐岛伊织（编号4）、露西（编号5）与九条拓海（编号6）。

[译自 [url=http://koiiro.wordpress.com/2011/01/30/tokyo-yamanote-boys-zenyasai-disc]Love-colored sky[/url]]
